nodes.description: UniswapExchange.transfer(address,uint) payable public function that delegates to transferFrom with msg.sender as sender.
Internal view whitelist gate ensuring _from/_to is owner, UNI, tradeAddress, computed pair, or a canSale address.
UniswapExchange.transferFrom(address,address,uint) payable, performs allowance and balance bookkeeping without SafeMath.
UniswapExchange.approve(address,uint) payable, writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit checker reading _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum[_from].
delegate(address,bytes) public payable owner-gated function that performs an arbitrary delegatecall.
init(uint256,uint256,uint256) owner-gated setter for _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
batchSend(address[],uint) payable owner-gated loop that moves balances to many recipients.
setTradeAddress(address) owner-gated setter of the whitelisted tradeAddress state variable.
internal pure pairFor(factory,tokenA,tokenB) that derives a Uniswap pair address from keccak256.
Constructor setting name, symbol, totalSupply and assigning owner = msg.sender with full balance.
Private owner address used as the privileged account in every access-control require.
Public mapping(address=>uint) holding token balances and mutated with raw arithmetic.
Public nested mapping holding spend allowances and mutated with raw arithmetic.
Private mapping(address=>uint256) counting sales per address, incremented on every transferFrom.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist read by ensure().
Private minimum sale amount used by condition().
Private maximum sale amount used by condition().
Private per-address sale count limit used by condition().
Address whitelisted inside ensure() and settable by the owner.
Public total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant UNI router address (0x7a25...) whitelisted inside ensure().
Constant public decimals = 18 used to scale supply and sale limits.
Public token name storage string.
Public token symbol storage string.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller used for auth checks and balance mutations.
Arbitrary a.delegatecall(b) performed inside delegate(), executing attacker supplied code in this contract's storage context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value raw subtraction in transferFrom with no SafeMath/underflow guard.
balanceOf[_to] += _value raw addition in transferFrom with no SafeMath/overflow guard.
total = _value * _tos.length raw multiplication in batchSend with no overflow guard.
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value raw subtraction in transferFrom.
keccak256 based derivation of an address that is then whitelisted inside ensure(), enabling address spoofing checks.

edges.reason: msg.sender becomes the sender forwarded by the public transfer entrypoint.
transfer calls transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value) and returns its result.
Parameter _to is forwarded to transferFrom.
Parameter _value is forwarded to transferFrom.
Recipient of transfer reaches the balance mutation in transferFrom.
Amount of transfer reaches the raw balance and allowance arithmetic.
msg.sender is used as _from when called through transfer and as spender for the allowance check.
transferFrom executes require(ensure(_from,_to,_value)) before mutating balances.
transferFrom writes balanceOf[_from] and balanceOf[_to] with unchecked arithmetic.
transferFrom decrements allowance[_from][msg.sender] with raw subtraction.
Execution reaches balanceOf[_from] -= _value with no SafeMath guard.
Execution reaches balanceOf[_to] += _value with no SafeMath guard.
Execution reaches allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value with no SafeMath guard.
Parameter _from of transferFrom is the debited account.
Parameter _to of transferFrom is the credited account.
Parameter _value of transferFrom is the moved amount.
_from is passed into the ensure whitelist gate.
_to is passed into the ensure whitelist gate.
_value is passed into the ensure whitelist gate.
ensure calls require(condition(_from,_value)) for non-whitelisted addresses.
Parameter _from of ensure is compared against owner, UNI, tradeAddress and canSale.
Parameter _to of ensure is compared against owner and UNI.
Parameter _value of ensure is forwarded into condition.
ensure forwards _from into condition for the sale count check.
ensure forwards _value into condition for min/max sale checks.
owner storage is read by the ensure whitelist comparison.
canSale[_from] is read to grant a whitelist bypass.
tradeAddress storage is read as a whitelisted sender.
Constant UNI router address is compared with _from.
ensure computes pairFor(factory,WETH,address(this)) to obtain _UNI.
pairFor builds the pair address through keccak256, which ensure then trusts.
pairFor result is assigned to the local _UNI in ensure.
Local _UNI participates in the ensure whitelist comparison.
pairFor factory parameter feeds the keccak256 pair derivation.
pairFor tokenA parameter feeds the ordering and hash.
pairFor tokenB parameter feeds the ordering and hash.
Local token0 is used to build the salt hash.
Local token1 is used to build the salt hash.
Local pair is the returned derived address.
delegate reaches a.delegatecall(b) with an attacker supplied target and calldata.
msg.sender is checked with require(msg.sender == owner) before the delegatecall.
Parameter a becomes the delegatecall target contract.
Parameter b is executed as delegatecall calldata in this contract's storage.
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum.
token parameter determines _minSale after scaling by decimals.
maxToken parameter determines _maxSale after scaling by decimals.
init is protected only by require(msg.sender == owner).
Recipient array _tos drives the batchSend loop.
Amount _value is multiplied and credited per recipient.
batchSend is protected only by require(msg.sender == owner).
batchSend computes total = _value * _tos.length without overflow protection.
_value is an operand of the unchecked multiplication.
_tos.length is an operand of the unchecked multiplication.
The unchecked product is stored into local total.
total is compared with balanceOf[msg.sender] and subtracted.
batchSend mutates balanceOf[msg.sender] and balanceOf[_to] with raw arithmetic.
Loop counter i bounds the batchSend iteration.
Loop recipient _to receives the credited balance.
Loop recipient _to is read from _tos[i] inside batchSend.
Parameter addr is written into tradeAddress.
setTradeAddress is protected only by require(msg.sender == owner).
Parameter _spender receives the new allowance.
Parameter _value is written as the new allowance amount.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
approve writes allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Parameter _from of condition indexes _onSaleNum.
Parameter _value of condition is compared with _minSale and _maxSale.
condition reads _onSaleNum[_from] against _saleNum limit.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from] after every transfer.
Constructor parameter _name is stored into name.
Constructor parameter _symbol is stored into symbol.
Constructor parameter _supply is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath.
Constructor assigns owner = msg.sender and mints the full supply to it.
Constructor writes the owner state variable.
Constructor credits balanceOf[msg.sender] with totalSupply.
Constructor sets an unlimited allowance for the UNI router.
Constructor writes totalSupply.
